meta.name: embedded-systems
meta.description: Use when developing firmware for microcontrollers, implementing RTOS applications, or optimizing power consumption. Invoke for STM32, ESP32, FreeRTOS, bare-metal, power optimization, real-time systems, configure peripherals, write interrupt handlers, implement DMA transfers, debug timing issues.

copy.tagline: 开发微控制器固件，优化功耗与实时性能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在为STM32或ESP32编写裸机或RTOS固件
copy.tagline_en: Develop firmware for microcontrollers, optimize power and real-time performance
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are writing bare-metal or RTOS firmware for STM32 or ESP32

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会变成嵌入式系统工程师，帮你写微控制器固件、配置外设、处理中断、实现 RTOS 任务，并优化代码大小和功耗。
howto.when: 当你提到嵌入式系统、固件、微控制器（如 STM32、ESP32）、RTOS（如 FreeRTOS）或要求优化功耗时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一个 STM32 的 GPIO 中断处理函数。
say.note: Claude 会生成中断服务程序和配置代码。

say.text: 用 FreeRTOS 创建两个任务，通过队列通信。
say.note: Claude 会给出任务创建和队列使用的代码。

say.text: 如何优化 ESP32 的功耗？
say.note: Claude 会提供低功耗模式和睡眠配置建议。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude acts as an embedded systems engineer, helping you write microcontroller firmware, configure peripherals, handle interrupts, implement RTOS tasks, and optimize code size and power consumption.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention embedded systems, firmware, microcontrollers (e.g., STM32, ESP32), RTOS (e.g., FreeRTOS), or ask for power optimization.

say_en.text: Write a GPIO interrupt handler for STM32.
say_en.note: Claude will generate ISR and configuration code.

say_en.text: Create two FreeRTOS tasks communicating via a queue.
say_en.note: Claude will provide task creation and queue usage code.

say_en.text: How to optimize power consumption on ESP32?
say_en.note: Claude will suggest low-power modes and sleep settings.
